name: wanapis-media
description: Generate images and video from inside Codex — including GPT Image 2.5 and MiniMax H3, with verified model parameters, async results and public-price budget estimates through one WanAPIs key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and video with cost estimates
interface.longDescription: Create images and video through verified WanAPIs adapters, including GPT Image 2.5 with independent quality and resolution and MiniMax H3 with native duration, priority and IR options. The model list intersects the current public catalog with supported adapters. Budget estimates use public pricing and an assumed group multiplier; actual image usage can cost more. Completed tasks report the gateway's billed amount.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 5-second video of a paper plane gliding over a city at dusk
Make a product hero image of a ceramic mug on a linen backdrop
What would a 10-second 1080p clip cost on each video model?
